d:
Karl-Anthony Towns continued his incredible start to the season, recording 22 points, 12 rebounds, 4 assists, and 3 blocks against his former team, the Minnesota Timberwolves! KAT extended his league-leading double-double streak to 15 consecutive games to start the season, continuing to make his presence felt on both ends of the floor.
